title: Traversal tools: safety-pin grapple + matchstick pole-vault (AUTH #021)
summary: Implement the v1 traversal-tools layer through the existing IVerbProvider (Bible §3.6, §14): the safety-pin grapple (swing/ascend/rappel) with the seamless tool state machine (aim -> deploy/mount -> verb -> auto-unhook -> reel -> coil to back), and the matchstick pole-vault. Real 1:1-scale carried objects (the sole SPEC §4 exception). Aim/targeting highlights valid anchors; the validator and route generator gain grapple/pole transitions. Tuned to movement.json grapple/poleVault.
deliverables: unity (grapple + pole-vault verb providers, tool state machine, aim UI)

acceptance_tests.test: Grapple works in all three modes (swing/ascend/rappel) via IVerbProvider without core changes; the state machine mounts the pin diegetically, auto-unhooks on arrival, and reels + coils to the back; constants come from movement.json grapple.
Matchstick pole-vault vaults a gap up to poleVault.maxGapA or a height up to maxHeightA at jog+.

The reachability validator and route generator include grapple and pole transitions (voids crossable, wall-smooth passable via an anchor above) within the movement.json limits; a generated route can author a grapple beat.
Tools render as real 1:1 objects lighting-matched to the splat, with tactile feedback (§9); aim is forgiving (snapAssistA). Feels great on the Owner's iPhone.

history.event: created by the Coordinator as the AUTH #021 traversal-tools follow-up (grapple + pole-vault).
